issues.reason: Quantifiers, generics & scope requires a (QuantifierPhrase <kind> <verb-lemma> "<word>") companion on the quantified range whenever the quantifier word is actually there, and "everything" is an explicit universal; both slots are already fixed by the parse's own range (thing) and verb (think), so the rule applies rather than running out.

gaps_confirmed: quantificational pronouns ("everything", "everyone", "nothing") — the instruction set never states the domain a universal pronoun ranges over, so the (Member $y thing) range is an unstated but well-typed extension of the "it -> thing" pronoun fallback
repair_summary: Added the missing (QuantifierPhrase thing think "everything") companion at (STV 1.0 0.99) beside the universal rule; nothing else changed.
notes: The exists-forall shape is right — a verbal predicate makes "a woman" a witness constant, not a generic — as are the dependent Skolem event, the 1.0/0.9 rule TV, the prepositional-verb (Of ...) oblique and the CamelCase-joined multi-word preposition InTermsOf.
